import pytest
from jinja2.nativetypes import NativeEnvironment

def test_type_error_on_render():
    template = NativeEnvironment().from_string(
        '{% block test %}{% for i in range(1) %}{{ loop.index }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %}{{ self.test() }}'
    )
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="sequence item 0: expected str instance, int found"):
        template.render()
